layer_3_action.subject: Bright, sunny view of a prehistoric coastal floodplain
features: flat, expansive terrain under clear skies
vibrant green salt-marsh ferns and thick mats of moss
shallow pools of sparkling, clear water reflecting the bright sky
distinct patches of peaty clay and lignite visible in the sun
distant, sun-drenched tree line of conifers and cycads
layer_3_action.action: Depict a cheerful and clear coastal floodplain at mid-day, emphasizing the bright sunlight, vibrant low-lying vegetation (ferns and moss, no grass), and the unique substrate made invitingly visible.

visuals.ground: Sticky black mud covered in a vibrant carpet of low-lying salt-marsh ferns and thick bryophyte mosses. Exposed patches of peaty clay and lignite clearly visible under direct sunlight. Absolutely no grass.
visuals.water: Numerous shallow, sparkling pools of clear water, brightly reflecting the blue sky, hinting at gentle tidal influence.
visuals.sky: Vibrant, clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, strong, direct mid-day sun casting crisp but friendly shadows.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Visibly wet, but sunlit, rich soil with prominent organic matter. Lignite fragments glisten under the sun. Dominated by fern fronds and moss textures.

mood: Bright, clear, inviting, serene, scientifically accurate (no grass)
